dependencyFindings.summary: Creator settings control plane is present and reused.
Telemetry dependency graph exists for this source-truth lane.

broadcastFindings.summary: Creator broadcast source contract defines audience/status/timeline/source truth.
Broadcast route persists creator_broadcasts source records.
Broadcast audiences use followers/subscribers terminology instead of legacy all_fans.

notificationFindings.summary: Follower notification fanout is bounded and not aggregate/unbounded.
Recipients resolve from canonical follower relationships with notification opt-in.
Fan Pass subscriber audience resolves from active creator subscriptions.
Per-recipient notification idempotency keys and deterministic document ids exist.

timelineFindings.summary: Creator profile timeline contract exists for drops and broadcasts.
Timeline excludes draft broadcasts and non-active/pending drops.
Timeline exposes source/empty/disabled states instead of treating missing data as zero.
Public creator profile route returns timeline source data.
Creator profile has compact broadcast timeline preview hooks.

telemetryFindings.summary: Broadcast creation and notification enqueue count are tracked.

fixesApplied: Created a creator broadcast source contract with follower/subscriber audience normalization.
Moved follower notification recipient selection and per-recipient idempotency into a shared helper.
Prepared creator profile timeline data for approved drops and published broadcasts.
nextFixOrder: Add the final creator profile timeline UI once product approves feed composition.
Promote notification queue processing if fanout grows beyond the bounded in-app batch limit.
